_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd pavlov_vr/egg-pavlov-v-r.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail adds the pavlov-vr tag, an automatic RCON port instead of the fixed 8188, reserves the status helper port the server always opens at the game port + 400 (fixed_ports), the no_console_input flag (the server reads no console commands), install sandbox defaults and resource hints, the server name, max players and API key written to Game.ini (file parser) before every start, makes the API key optional (-KEY only when set; the server still runs, it just isn't listed), drops the CHANGE_ME RCON password default (staff set one at creation), fixes the RconSettings.txt placeholders ({{env.X}} to {{server.environment.X}}), stops with Ctrl+C (upstream's ^^C was a kill), downloads Game.ini and RconSettings.txt from the pinned commit instead of the old parkervcp/eggs paths (failed downloads fail the install), makes the install fail when SteamCMD (or SteamCMD itself) didn't download, and says in the description which port pair a node needs. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: Pavlov VR
author: admin@devil.wtf
description: Pavlov VR is a multiplayer shooter in VR with heavy focus on community features. Realistic reloading features and fast paced combat as part of the core experience. Play the #1 most popular VR shooter on PC today. Needs two ports on the node: the main port and the main port + 400 exactly (the status helper the server always opens), e.g. 7777 and 8177; staff add such pairs under Nodes, Allocations, Pair with +400. RCON takes one more port, preferably the main port + 1.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#

if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Downloading SteamCMD failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/Pavlov/Binaries/Linux/PavlovServer-Linux-Shipping" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Pavlov VR dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x "/mnt/server/Pavlov/Binaries/Linux/PavlovServer-Linux-Shipping"

# Install Configuration Files
mkdir -p /mnt/server/Pavlov/Saved/Logs
mkdir -p /mnt/server/Pavlov/Saved/Config/LinuxServer
mkdir -p /mnt/server/Pavlov/Saved/maps


cd /mnt/server/Pavlov/Saved/Config/LinuxServer
if [ ! -f Game.ini ]; then
    echo -e "Downloading Pavlov VR Game.ini"
    curl -fsSL -o Game.ini https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/pavlov_vr/Game.ini || { echo "Downloading Game.ini failed"; rm -f Game.ini; exit 1; }
fi

cd /mnt/server/Pavlov/Saved/Config
if [ ! -f RconSettings.txt ]; then
    echo -e "Downloading Pavlov VR RconSettings.txt"
    curl -fsSL -o RconSettings.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/pavlov_vr/RconSettings.txt || { echo "Downloading RconSettings.txt failed"; rm -f RconSettings.txt; exit 1; }
fi

cd /mnt/server/
if [ -f PavlovServer.sh ]; then
    rm PavlovServer.sh
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for Pavlov's RCON (RconSettings.txt), for RCON tools. At least 8 letters, digits, ., - or _.

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: RCON port (TCP). Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Auto-update server
variables.description:
This is to enable auto-updating for servers.

Default is 0. Set to 1 to update

variables.name: Beta id
variables.description: Beta branch of a steam app

variables.name: Api key
variables.description: Optional: the API key from Vankrupt (https://pavlov-ms.vankrupt.com/servers/v1/key) that lists the server in the server browser. Without one the server still runs but isn't listed.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server list (no double quotes or backslashes). Written to Game.ini.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: How many players may join (up to 24 on PC; 10 for Shack). Written to Game.ini.
